sections.heading: Get in touch
sections.lead: Different questions go to different people. Here is who.

items.title: Groups and individuals
items.body: Registration, training, a field officer visit, or anything about your own group. Monday to Saturday, 8am–6pm.

items.title: Partnerships
items.body: Government, financial institutions, donors and corporate sponsors. We will ask what you need and what you require before proposing anything.

items.title: Events and media
items.body: Convenings, conferences, invitations and press enquiries.

items.title: Complaints
items.body: In Kiswahili or English. Acknowledged within two working days, answered within fourteen. You may escalate beyond us without our permission.

sections.heading: Where we are

requirementList.title: Head office
requirementList.body: Nairobi, Kenya. Visitors are welcome; call ahead so the right person is in.

requirementList.title: Field officers
requirementList.body: Across Nairobi and partner counties, including evenings and weekends.

sections.fineprint: Add the full postal address, physical address and map before publication.

media.alt: A community group meeting under a tree

sections.body: CECF never asks for money by phone. Our assistance is free, and government fees are paid directly to the issuing office. If anybody asks you to pay CECF, it is not us. Call 0722 156 397 and tell us.
